description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an inter‑frameweave structural block containing cross‑woven frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::INTERFRAMEWEAVE

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [INTERWEAVE-ALPHA]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IW1
    FRAME::INNER

  [INTERWEAVE-BETA]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IW2
    FRAME::OUTER

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    INTERWEAVESET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    INTERWEAVESET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-INTERFRAMEWEAVE}
  M7-L6-K5-J4

<END-INTERFRAMEWEAVE>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire interframeweave block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
